name: Luoyang Bearing Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Luoyang Bearing Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies ball and roller bearings in China and Internationally. The company provides deep groove and self-aligning ball, cylindrical and spherical roller, needle roller, angular contact ball, tapered roller, thrust ball and roller, railway, and slewing bearings; clutch bearing, spherical plain bearing, thin section bearings, and rolling mill, sealed four-row tapered roller, split, windmill, machine tool, and automobile bearings. Its products are applied in metallurgic, energy, railway, machine tool, paper making, harbor machinery, aviation, and aerospace, agriculture, cars, trucks and buses, coal, construction machinery, electric motors, food,…
